authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FC-NC invocation initial states from doctor-contract.v4. It does not author a process/module trace. It does not author a sentinel executable or sentinel-path bytes. It does not author report bytes. It does not author a consent record. It does not assign CA-1 process-tree containment to G12 (that property rides G21). It does not execute FC-NC. It does not close OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-114. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING at FC-NC without inventing a trace, a sentinel implementation, or report goldens. doctor v4 exactByteIntent pins a process/module trace, a sentinel-writing component fixture, and report bytes; this catalog records the two named postures as initial states. The pinned artifacts remain unauthored.

doctorV4.fcNcExactByteIntent: A process/module trace of the doctor invocation - the evidence form DR-G03 already names - plus a component fixture whose executable writes a sentinel byte to a known path on any execution, plus the doctor report. The fixture pins the trace, the sentinel path's pre/post state, and the report bytes.
